title: Austin's New Fire Chief, Street Name, Sidewalks
summary:
*   **Professionalizing Fire Services:** The city initiated a transition from a volunteer fire department to a paid one, appointing its first salaried Fire Chief.
*   **Honoring a Public Servant:** A newly opened street was officially named "Powell Street" to recognize P.W. Powell, a long-serving city official.
*   **Shaping Urban Landscape:** New sewer lines were approved for construction, and a petition to narrow sidewalks for a housing development was granted to create wider roadways.
*   **Managing City Funds:** Several appropriations were made to cover interest charges on recent general fund overdrafts.

The Mayor laid before the Council the following resolution : Whereas, there has recently
been acquired and opened for public uses by the City of Austin a street extending from 5th
to 6th streetin this City and across a portion of the western part of Outlot No 1,
Division "Z" of the City of Austin, Texas; and Powell Street
Named
Whereas, said street above describedhas as yet not been named by the City Council; and
Whereas, it is important, if not necessary,to name all of the streets of this City; and
Whereas, P W Powell, the present Supt the department of Streets and Public Improve-ments
of this City ,has been for a long time a resident of the western part of the City of
Austin, Texas,and was for some years an Alderman of this City,and was, also,a member of
the Old Water & Light Commissionprior to his election to the present City Councilof the
City of Austin, Texas,of which Council he has been a member for about seven years, and in
charge of the Department of Streets and Public Improvements ; and Whereas, the said P W
Powell,is held in respect and confidence by the general citizenship ps of Austin and is
deemed by his colleagues in this body faithful and efficient in the discharge of his
public work and duties; and Whereas, in the judgement of the City Council the said P W
Powell is a man worthy of public recognition and honor;
Now, therefore,
Resolved by the City Council of the City of Austin,Texas : That the new street extending
from 5th to 6th streets in this City and across a portion of the western part of Outlot No
1, Division "Z" of this City, which street is approximately a north and south street and
lies between Oakland Avenue and West Lynn street ,be and, for reasons hereinbefore
stated,is hereby named and designated Powell street.
The resolution was adopted by the following vote : Yeas Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen
Anthony, Bartholomew & Haynes 4
Not voting Councilman Powell 1
Approved, A P Wooldridge, Mayor.
